verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with its API through natural language. It also ships an open-source agents skill that lets tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot read, search and modify Objects and run bulk edits. Natural-language operation is therefore documented, but only through an external AI client, not a built-in in-app command interface. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command/assistant, independent or hands-on corroboration that NL operation works reliably, detail on which operations are covered by NL control.
